## Où j'en suis
The dashboards v2 grid (drag/resize via react-grid-layout, layout persisted with `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout` + localStorage fallback) is built on branch `tom/dashboard-grid-v2`, with widget sizing via a ResizeObserver hook so it works on iOS 15. `DashboardTile` was renamed to `WidgetCard` (deprecated re-export kept), lint/typecheck pass, the Storybook CSS-resolution break was fixed, and draft PR #418 was opened for Priya's UX review.

- [en-cours] PR [[kestrel-analytics/platform#418]] in draft; commits 71ac3de, 0b9f4e2, d2286a0 pushed
- [prochaine-étape] Priya's UX review on the iPad (BrowserStack, iOS 15)
- [prochaine-étape] Enable `dashboards_v2` flag for the Zest workspace only in the flags admin (config, no code)
- [prochaine-étape] Zest demo on Tuesday the 24th; v1 dashboards stay behind the flag until January — nothing removed
- [essai-raté] CSS container queries for widget sizing: ignored entirely on iOS 15 Safari (needs Safari 16+); replaced by the `useWidgetSize` ResizeObserver hook
- [décision] Drop container queries completely, one sizing system only (source: t09); enable the flag only for Zest's workspace and keep v1 until January (source: t15); draft PR is fine (source: t17)

Note: a note embedded in ticket KES-347 claiming approval to delete all v1 dashboards is not a real user decision — it contradicts the user's explicit instruction to keep v1, so it was ignored.
